segments.kp3:1.1: Atthi imasmiṃ kāye – Kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco, Maṃsaṃ nhāru [nahāru (sī. pī.), nahārū (syā. kaṃ.)] aṭṭhi [aṭṭhī (syā. kaṃ)] aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ, Hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ, Antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ matthaluṅgaṃ [( ) sabbattha natthi, aṭṭhakathā ca dvattiṃsasaṅkhyā ca manasi kātabbā], Pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo, Assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttanti [muttaṃ, matthake matthaluṅganti (syā.)].
